Headline: Chief Technology Officer in digital healthcare
Bio:
I get fired up creating disruptive new technology products and commercialising them. Over 24 years I have given heart and soul to twelve new technology products across four different industries, in corporations and in start-ups. I’ve had two successful exits after one venture that didn’t work out. I learnt a lot from the successes, but even more from the failure.

I learnt to use startup agility to out-manoeuvre much better funded competitors and win critical contracts (~£1m).

Working in the healthcare industry is hugely motivating. We get to help very sick people, partner with lots of deeply impressive healthcare professionals and work on cutting edge technology, does it get better than that?

🪴As a UKCP accredited psychotherapeutic counsellor I work within an integrative framework to provide a safe and holding space for my clients to explore their past, present and future.

🪴I bring in an awareness of the body and how we can hold trauma. Within my framework I use my understanding of psychodynamic, humanistic and CBT approaches.

🪴My key  career experience areas are in health - paediatric nursing and health visiting, team leader and  management, hospitality and customer service. I hold BA (Hons) in Health Visiting and Diploma in Nursing specialising in Children’s Nursing.

🪴I am currently also working two days a week as a Health Trainer for Everyone Health/Healthy You. Providing one-to-one healthy lifestyle support.

The success of our medical treatments is substantiated by 450,000 patients treated and 4,000 prescribing doctors who trust in the rigour and effectiveness of our methods. These figures make PronoKal Group the top company in our sector.
Since its inception, the company has committed itself to rigour and science, launching numerous studies to demonstrate the efficacy and safety of a Protein Diet versus a low calorie diet. So far over 15 studies have been conducted, half of which have been published and presented at international scientific meetings.

Since its inception, the company has committed itself to rigour and science, launching numerous studies to demonstrate the efficacy and safety of a Protein Diet versus a low calorie diet. So far over 15 studies have been conducted, half of which have been published and presented at international scientific meetings.
